title: Robe Hook 2-Inch Solid Brass Wall Mount | Malibu Robe Hooks | Allied Brass | Bathroom Robe Hook Wall Hook | Allied Brass
description:
Stop draping robes and towels over doors and chairs. This wall-mounted robe hook (also called a towel hook or bathroom wall hook) adds a dedicated hanging spot right where you need it.

Highlights:
- Keep daily essentials organized with a compact robe hook/towel hook near the shower, tub, or vanity
- Built for long-term use with solid brass construction (brass construction)
- Designed to coordinate with the Malibu robe hooks collection for transitional bathroom hardware and versatile bath accessories
- Choose a look that matches your bath space with multiple designer finish options available
- Includes color-coordinated mounting hardware for a clean, finished installation

Specs & Installation:
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 2 in. x 2 in. x 2.64 in.
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 4 in. x 6 in. x 10 in.
- Shipping weight: 1 lb.
- Mounting: wall mount / wall-mounted / wall hanging
- Assembled in the USA
- Limited Lifetime Warranty
